newsitem.title: UK: Algerian Feb crude price 5 cts up, Syrian not set.
newsitem.headline: Algerian Feb crude price 5 cts up, Syrian not set.

text.p: The February price for Algerian Saharan Blend crude has been agreed by contract lifters and state oil company Sonatrach at Dated Brent +78/79 cents, term contract holders said on Monday.
This is a slight increase on the Official Selling Price (OSP) of Dated Brent +73/74 set for January barrels.
Negotiations for February Syrian crude prices were still on-going on Monday morning but were expected to be resolved in the next two days, European traders said.
Contract lifters expected the price for Syrian Light to be settled at Dated Brent -25 to -30 cents, just up from the January price of Dated Brent -35 cents.
State oil company Sytrol has offered a price of Dated Brent -$4.65 a barrel for its heavier Souedie grade but lifters were holding back for a discount of $5 to Dated Brent, they said.
